content.short: Ualá is a Latin American digital wallet and neobank with a card, account, investments and credit.
content.description: Ualá is a Latin American fintech and digital wallet, founded in Argentina, that gives millions of users a card linked to an app-based account for payments, transfers and money management. Beyond everyday spending, Ualá offers a high-yield savings account in pesos and dollars, personal loans, a credit card, insurance and a range of investments including fixed-term deposits, mutual funds, stocks, bonds and CEDEARs. It has expanded across Argentina, Mexico and Colombia, aimed at people who are underbanked or dissatisfied with traditional banks. By bundling a card, account, credit and investments for a large, young population, it competes with banks and other regional fintechs to be a primary financial platform.
